file_insights.description: Comprehensive test suite for cycling dynamics FIT file export

patterns_discovered: Systematic test generation with multiple scenarios (varying dynamics, partial dynamics, boundary values)
Detailed roundtrip testing for different cycling metrics
Encoding and decoding validation for FIT file specifications
Test helper functions to generate sample ride data with different characteristics

Metrics like balance and effectiveness require bit manipulation during encoding
Need to handle both integer and floating-point value representations
Power phase angles require precise conversion and boundary checks

tests_implemented: Correct value encoding for left/right balance

recommendations: Continue developing comprehensive test cases for edge cases
Add more boundary value tests for extreme cycling metrics
Consider creating a generalized test data generation utility
Document the FIT file encoding specifics for future reference
